decision: TAKE 783ccf0fdd #14029 build_web and deploy_web split in release.yml, ported by hand; changed owner path .github/workflows/release.yml for product-identity-release-ownership and release-package-ownership
why: KAT-3604 skipped it because release.yml is Kata-owned. The port keeps what made it Kata's: the katacode-web project guard, the .vercel/project.json pin, KATACODE_* names and kata.sh domain defaults, ubuntu-24.04 runners, the dry_run and preview exclusions, and no marketing jobs. Only the Vercel build moves ahead of the GitHub Release; the alias stays behind it
evidence: actionlint reports only the two findings already on main; check-workflow-references passes; trusted checker in ci mode exits 0 with both checks PASS and CHANGED_RETAINED_OUTCOMES ids=product-identity-release-ownership,release-package-ownership; PR body lists the scratch-repo run of the real build_web and deploy_web jobs

decision: ADAPT 783ccf0fdd build_web: needs quality, test, and test_server as well as preflight and relay_public_config; the project guard is an exact name match, in scripts/assert-hosted-web-project.ts; build_web emits channel_name, channel_domain, and router_domain for deploy_web
why: Upstream builds before any gate passes, which would stage a production deployment, and move the project's own *.vercel.app hostname, for a commit that later fails its checks. Its guard was a substring and prefix match, so katacode-web-staging passed. The gates finish long before the desktop builds, so the overlap stays
evidence: scripts/assert-hosted-web-project.test.ts rejects katacode-web-staging, old-katacode-web, katacode-web2, and kata-code; scratch-repo runs show build_web starting after the gates and before release finishes

decision: SKIP 783ccf0fdd build_marketing, deploy_marketing, blacksmith runner labels, T3CODE_* names, and app.t3.codes domain defaults
why: Kata hosts marketing outside this workflow and does not deploy it from a release; Kata releases run on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04; Kata names are KATACODE_* with kata.sh domains
evidence: git grep -in marketing .github/workflows/release.yml is empty; no blacksmith label in release.yml

decision: TAKE the release.md ordering text; REPLACE upstream's claim that the project's *.vercel.app hostname is behind Vercel SSO
why: Upstream says the hostname that --skip-domain still moves is SSO-protected. On 2026-10-02 https://katacode-web.vercel.app answered HTTP 200 and served the hosted app without sign-in, while nightly.app.kata.sh, latest.app.kata.sh, and app.kata.sh redirected to Vercel sign-in
evidence: curl -sI https://katacode-web.vercel.app returned HTTP/2 200; the other three returned 302 to vercel.com/sso-api
result: documented as residual exposure; the client can be loaded there before its npm package is published
